taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-04
Curve type: QHA-type
Aquifer depth: 39.15 – 43.15 m and > 47.47 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of at least 55–60 m to fully penetrate and exploit the deeper low-resistivity aquifer horizon identified below 47.47 m. Ensure appropriate screen placement and gravel packing across the saturated zones to maximize yield and prevent silt intrusion.
